name: Confetti Dot Field
description: A scatter of colored rings and dots on charcoal, catching light like a page of confetti under low light.

code.style: --rule: ( @place-cell: center; @size: 50%; transform-origin: -50% 50%; transform: translateX(100%) rotate(calc(1turn / @size() * @i())); :after, :before { content: ''; position: absolute; } :after { @size: 100% 72%; right: 0%; background: radial-gradient(@pd(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) 30%, transparent 0) 2% 50% / 25% 25% no-repeat, radial-gradient(var(--color0) 50%, transparent 0) 5% 50% / 25% 25% no-repeat, radial-gradient(@pd(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) 70%, transparent 0) 8% 50% / 30% 30% no-repeat, radial-gradient(var(--color0) 60%, transparent 0) 0% 50% / 50% 50% no-repeat, radial-gradient(@pd(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) 70%, transparent 0) } :before { @size: 24%; left: -27%; transform-origin: -100% center; transform: rotate(22deg); background: radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 80%, @pd(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) 50%, transparent 0) 20% 50% / 40% 40% no-repeat, radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 80%, var(--color0) 50%, transparent 0) 10% 50% / 80% 80% no-repeat, radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 80%, @pd(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) 50%, transparent 0) 0 / 100% 100% no-repeat; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); background-image: radial-gradient(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) 4%, transparent 0), radial-gradient(var(--color0) 8%, transparent 0), radial-gradient(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)) 10%, transparent 0); overflow:hidden; }
